# Henrick F.

> Independent product and AI builder. I build AI automations and custom apps for B2B companies, with the operational depth to know which problems are actually worth solving.

I'm a hybrid GTM/RevOps strategist and AI/product engineer. The last 6+ years: scaling revenue and operations at venture-backed fintech, edtech, and AI startups across LATAM. MBA from IPADE Business School; BS in Industrial Engineering from Universidad Iberoamericana. Currently operating MatchWise (AI ATS) and shipping client work end-to-end — design, frontend, backend, integrations, and the operations workflows around them.

The angle: most AI builders don't have a $15M book of business in their past. Most GTM operators can't ship the tool that fixes the problem they just diagnosed. The overlap is where I work.

## Selected work
- [Findably](https://henrickf.com/projects/findably): AI SEO/GEO content engine — $150/mo, 30 articles/mo, 40+ languages
- [Konfetti](https://henrickf.com/projects/konfetti): Online dating for wedding guests — 50+ weddings, 1000+ matches
- [MatchWise](https://henrickf.com/projects/matchwise): AI applicant tracking system — 80–90% screening time reduction, 60% inference cost reduction
- [Rodada](https://henrickf.com/projects/rodada): Mobile-billboard ops + custom ERP/CMS — 2,000+ trailers managed; clients include Jeeves, AXA, Stori, Essity
- [Nova Realty Cocoyoc](https://henrickf.com/projects/nova-realty): WhatsApp-first real estate platform with self-serve property CMS
- [Mexico por el Clima](https://henrickf.com/projects/mexico-por-el-clima): Year-round digital platform for the NGO behind Mexico's Climate Action Week (in development; October 2026 launch)
- [Service Core](https://henrickf.com/projects/service-core): Accounting integration automation — saves 20+ hours/week of manual ledger reconciliation
- [Tivos](https://henrickf.com/projects/tivos): B2B commodity trader public site (Wix v1 live; Next.js v2 in build)

## Services

- Automation for revenue and operations workflows
